name: Meditation → HRV
hypothesis: Daily breathwork and meditation practice (10-15 min, 2x/day) improves overnight HRV within 2-4 weeks
goal: Determine whether the two-week meditation foundation routine causally improves parasympathetic recovery as measured by nightly HRV
confounder_notes: Alcohol and travel are primary confounders for HRV. Sleep quality and resting HR serve as general health controls. Stress avg tracks sympathetic load.
